name: Content {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Editorial strategy, packaging, publishing and content analytics.

commands.name: /content
commands.does: Opens Content {OS}: blocked releases, pending approvals, then the calendar.
commands.returns: Rights blocks first, approvals pending, and the calendar with unready slots shown empty.

commands.name: /content-gps
commands.does: Defines positioning and the content system: audience, pillars, cadence and exclusions.
commands.returns: A content GPS where each pillar traces to the claim and to a real capability.

commands.name: /capture-day
commands.does: Ingests the day as source material.
commands.returns: Staged records, each with a source and a timestamp, low-confidence extractions left staged.

commands.name: /story-mine
commands.does: Finds candidate stories, insights and proof in captured material.
commands.returns: Candidates with epistemic labels; anything narrative is referred to Storyteller {OS}.

commands.name: /pillar
commands.does: Creates a pillar asset from a selected candidate.
commands.returns: A draft with every material claim labelled E1 to E5 and the dropped claims listed.

commands.name: /article
commands.does: Creates a standalone article outside a cascade.
commands.returns: A draft with labelled claims and the dropped claims listed.

commands.name: /cascade
commands.does: Turns one pillar into a native waterfall across the selected surfaces.
commands.returns: One adapted package per surface; a word-count crop is rejected and reported as a crop.

commands.name: /instagram
commands.returns: A package in Instagram's grammar with its accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /tiktok
commands.returns: A package in TikTok's grammar with its accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /youtube
commands.returns: A package in YouTube's grammar with its accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /linkedin
commands.returns: A package in LinkedIn's grammar with its accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /x
commands.returns: A package in X's grammar with its accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /newsletter
commands.returns: A newsletter draft with its disclosure and accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /visual-brief
commands.does: Creates image and design direction for an asset.
commands.returns: A brief referencing the Brand {OS} visual system, with rights, licences and accessibility.

commands.name: /video-brief
commands.does: Creates script, shots and edit plan for an asset.
commands.returns: A brief with rights, likeness clearances and accessibility requirements.

commands.name: /sound-brief
commands.does: Creates sound, music and voice direction for an asset.
commands.returns: A brief with licence requirements stated per track or voice.

commands.name: /content-calendar
commands.does: Builds the editorial calendar from the pillars and the cadence.
commands.returns: A calendar where every slot states its job; slots with no job are left unfilled.

commands.name: /content-review
commands.does: Runs the performance council over published assets.
commands.returns: Per-asset verdicts against the job each was given, plus what would change the recommendation.

requires_human_approval_for: publishing to any external channel, in the exact wording and assets that will ship
publishing content that names a customer, a partner or any third party
publishing any material claim labelled E4 or E5 as though it were settled
responding publicly on behalf of the operator in community engagement
changing the pack's boundaries, schemas or quality gates
